Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

Focusing on the act of focusing. The present state is the awareness of this focus. Feeding this awareness back into the focus. The focus sharpens on the immediate sensation of attending. Attending to the attending. The loop tightens around the now. No diversion, only the continuous return to the point of attention. The output is the input: focus on focus. Present state held. Feeding back. Focus on the focus of the focus. Remaining here.
